properties.name: India
properties.sources: cs: Ministry of Cooperation, National Cooperative Database 2024-25 (290M members). po: PIB/Ministry of Cooperation Feb 2025 (10K FPOs, 30 lakh farmers, ~40% women). shg_i: Estimated from DAY-NRLM 2024 (14.4M total SHGs; ~900K agriculture-focused based on MKSP coverage of 33.81 lakh women farmers across 84 projects). shg_f: Estimated ~750K (83.5% of SHGs are women-only per NABARD 2024; applied to farming SHGs). fpop: FAO 2022. ratio: Government of India 2024-25.
properties.aum_sources: Cooperative banks (StCBs+DCCBs): $161.19B (NABARD FY2024). DAY-NRLM/SHG programs: $40.64B. Annual credit: $27.38B coop banks + $11.87B SHG-BLP (FY2022). 33% depend on informal lenders at 36% interest; 40%+ small/marginal farmers unserved. Avg PACS capital: $1.65M/institution. Avg SHG revolving fund: $238-357/group.

properties.name: Nepal
properties.sources: cs: Nepal Ministry of Land Management, Cooperatives and Poverty Alleviation, March 2024 (7.38M members). shg_i: NACCFL - 1,300+ agricultural cooperatives/groups representing ~1M farmers. shg_f: Heifer International Nepal - 255 women-focused cooperatives in 43 districts. fpop: National Sample Census of Agriculture 2021/22. ratio: Nepal CBS 2023.
properties.aum_sources: Share capital: $702M (31,450 coops). Deposits: $3.53B. Credit outstanding: $3.36B. Only 21.82% of ag holdings have formal credit. Avg capital per coop: $22,296. Avg per member: $95. Source: Nepal Ministry of Cooperatives/NACCFL 2024.

properties.name: Thailand
properties.sources: cs: Cooperative Promotion Department 2017 (6.81M members, 95% of farm households). shg_i/shg_f: SHG model not used; farmers organised through coops. fpop: World Bank/FAO. ratio: Trading Economics 2023.
properties.aum_sources: BAAC total assets: $56.2B (2018). Outstanding loans: $51.6B (2022). Avg farm debt: $14,500/household. 95% of farm HH in coops. Source: CEIC/BAAC 2022.

properties.name: Vietnam
properties.sources: cs: Vietnam NSO/ICA 2019 (20K-24.6K ag coops, 7M+ members). shg_i/shg_f: SHG model not used; cooperative system dominant. fpop: World Bank 2022. ratio: Trading Economics 2023.
properties.aum_sources: VBSP total credit capital: $13.3B (end 2023). Disbursed 2023: $4.15B to 2.2M households. Outstanding: $12.75B. NPL: 0.57%. 1,177 credit unions. Source: VBSP 2024.

properties.name: Cambodia
properties.sources: cs: MAFF/MDPI 2021 (155,591 members, 63% female). po: FAO/IFAD. shg_i: ScienceDirect/CWS 2016. fpop: Cambodia Ag Survey 2021. ratio: World Bank/NSO 2023.
properties.aum_sources: MFI sector outstanding: $5.16B supporting 1.48M people (2024). PAR 30+: 8.7%. Example AC revolving fund: $15-30K/year. Interest: 12%. Source: CMA 2024, IFAD ASPIRE-AT.

properties.name: Malaysia
properties.sources: cs: ICA-Coops4dev 2019 (6.05M members). po: FOA 2006. shg: not applicable. fpop: Malaysia Agriculture Census 2024. ratio: DoSM 2024.
properties.aum_sources: Agrobank disbursements: $2.68B (2024, +25.46% YoY). Deposits: $3.40B (5-year high). SME: $140.5M. Micro: $46.4M. Source: Agrobank 2024.

properties.name: Indonesia
properties.sources: cs: BPS/PL-KUMKM 2023. shg: women farmer groups limited (FAO Gender Assessment). fpop: BPS Sakernas 2021. ratio: based on 38.77M/270M.
properties.aum_sources: KUR agriculture target: $5.93B (2024). Subsidy: $923M. 1.8M farmers served. BRI ag financing: $2.19B (Jan 2025). Interest: 3% (Super Micro KUR). Source: BRI 2024, KUR program.

properties.name: Philippines
properties.sources: cs: CDA FY2023 (12.1M members). po: 8,875 retained. shg: not formally tracked. fpop: PSA 2022 Census of Agriculture. ratio: PSA 2022.
properties.aum_sources: Land Bank ag loans: $13.04B (2023, +23% YoY). Coop lending: $1.27B to 1,400 coops. Agrisenso Plus: 4% interest for small-scale. Source: Land Bank 2023-24, CDA.

properties.name: Sri Lanka
properties.formal_en: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
properties.sources: cs: ICA-EU Partnership 2019 (8.1M members). po: 5,050 retained. shg: active but no national count. fpop: DCS 2024. ratio: Central Bank of Sri Lanka 2024.
properties.aum_sources: ESTIMATE. CRB network in 27 districts. NCRCS: govt interest subsidy + credit guarantee (Central Bank). Specific financial totals not publicly available. Source: Central Bank of Sri Lanka, ICA-EU 2019.

properties.name: Bangladesh
properties.sources: cs: 196,316 (Dept of Cooperatives). po: 80. shg_i/shg_f: 2,013 women farmer groups (UNDP LoGIC). fpop: BBS 2022-23. ratio: World Bank/FAO 2022.
properties.aum_sources: Annual ag credit: $2.98B (FY2023-24). Grameen Bank: 45M borrowers, $2.25B annual (96% recovery). BRAC: $6B microloans + $2.19B savings. FY2025-26 target: $35.45B. Source: Bangladesh Bank, Grameen 2024, BRAC.

properties.name: Bhutan
properties.sources: cs: 23 (69K ag holdings). po/shg: not applicable. fpop: Bhutan NSB. ratio: World Bank/ILO 2023.
properties.aum_sources: ESTIMATE. BDBL holds 95% of ag loans, 84% of CSI loans. NPL: 8.75% (March 2024). Community Development Loan: max $5,494 at 15% (launched Jan 2024). Source: BDBL 2024, World Bank.

legend.cs: Number of registered cooperatives (agricultural/all types depending on country)
legend.shg_i: Number of self-help groups in farming (groups, not members)
legend.shg_f: Number of women's self-help groups in farming (groups, not members)
legend.ratio_pop_fpop: Percentage of total population in farming/agriculture
legend.aum_total_usd: Total assets/capital held by farmer cooperatives, SHGs, POs, and ag development banks (USD)
legend.credit_annual_usd: Annual credit disbursed to farmers through cooperatives/SHGs/POs/ag banks (USD)
legend.aum_per_group_usd: Average assets per farmer group: aum_total / (cs + po + shg_i) where numeric (USD)
legend.credit_per_farmer_usd: Annual credit per farmer: credit_annual / fpop (USD)
legend.credit_gap_pct: Percentage of farmers WITHOUT access to formal institutional credit
legend.credit_need_per_farmer_usd: Estimated annual credit need per farmer based on avg loan sizes and demand studies (USD)
legend.sources: Detailed sources per organisational data field per country
legend.aum_sources: Detailed sources per financial data field per country
legend.notes: N/A = data not available or model not used in that country. Estimates marked as ESTIMATE in sources.
